FAQ

CRM Questions, Answered

Clear answers before you build a CRM with WebDone Co.

Can you build a custom CRM instead of using a ready-made tool?+
Yes. We can build a custom CRM when your workflow needs custom stages, dashboards, roles, or automations that standard tools do not handle well.
Can you connect website forms and WhatsApp leads?+
Yes. We can plan lead capture from your website forms and WhatsApp follow-up flows depending on the tools and APIs available.
Do we need to migrate existing data?+
If you have spreadsheets or old CRM data, we can clean and import the important fields into the new structure.
How long does a CRM project take?+
A focused CRM setup can take 2–4 weeks. More advanced systems with automation, integrations, and reporting can take 4–8+ weeks.
Can different team members have different access?+
Yes. We can create different access levels for owners, managers, sales reps, support, or admins.
Can we add more modules later?+
Yes. A good CRM should be expandable. We can start with the core sales pipeline and add modules later.
